name: Differential Equations
strandNote: Desk quant and rates: pricing models, mean-reverting short rates.
description: Solve equations about rates of change, from mean-reverting rates to coupled systems.

lessonNames.l3-integrating-factor: Linear equations and the integrating factor
lessonNames.l18-four-decimal-places: Matching a closed form to four decimals

lessonObjectives.l1-equations-about-rates: Write a differential equation from a story about a rate, and check a proposed solution.
lessonObjectives.l2-separable: Solve a separable equation, including continuous compounding and logistic growth.
lessonObjectives.l3-integrating-factor: Solve a first-order linear equation with an integrating factor.
lessonObjectives.l4-slope-fields: Sketch a slope field and classify equilibria as stable or unstable.
lessonObjectives.l5-mean-reversion: Solve $dr/dt = \kappa(\theta - r)$ and read the half-life of a rate’s pull to its mean.
lessonObjectives.l6-second-order: Recognise a second-order linear equation and why it needs two starting values.
lessonObjectives.l7-characteristic-equation: Solve a constant-coefficient equation from its characteristic roots, real or complex.
lessonObjectives.l8-forcing: Find a particular solution by undetermined coefficients, and add the general solution.
lessonObjectives.l9-damping-and-resonance: Read under-, over- and critical damping from the roots, and find when forcing resonates.
lessonObjectives.l10-first-order-systems: Write a higher-order equation as a system, and solve a linear system with eigenvectors.
lessonObjectives.l11-phase-plane: Sketch trajectories in the phase plane for nodes, saddles, spirals and centres.
lessonObjectives.l12-stability: Decide an equilibrium’s stability from the trace and determinant.
lessonObjectives.l13-linearising: Linearise a nonlinear system at an equilibrium with the Jacobian, as in predator and prey.
lessonObjectives.l14-laplace-transform: Compute Laplace transforms from the definition and a table.
lessonObjectives.l15-solving-with-laplace: Solve an initial value problem with the Laplace transform and partial fractions.
lessonObjectives.l16-euler-method: Step a solution forward with Euler’s method in NumPy and watch the error shrink with the step.
lessonObjectives.l17-runge-kutta: Implement fourth-order Runge-Kutta and compare its error with Euler’s.
lessonObjectives.l18-four-decimal-places: Solve the Vasicek drift numerically and match its closed form to four decimal places.
